newsitem.title: USA: Thermo Cardiosystems to take Q4 charge.
newsitem.headline: Thermo Cardiosystems to take Q4 charge.

text.p: Thermo Cardiosystems Inc said Friday it will take a charge of about $5 million against its fourth quarter earnings for its $5 million cash acquisition of all the assets and certain liabilities of Nimbus Medical Inc, which it completed today.
Nimbus Medical, based in Rancho Cordova, California, carries out research in artificial heart technology, mostly in ventricular-assist devices and total artificial hearts.

Thermo Cardiosystems did not give any estimates for its earnings, other than to say it will take the charge. It will take the charge because most of Nimbus' assets consist of in-process research and development, it said.
